name: beeper
title: Beeper Desktop
description: Access your chats from Beeper Desktop (requires Beeper Desktop API to be enabled)
author: batuhan

commands.name: focus-app
commands.title: Focus Beeper Desktop
commands.description: Bring Beeper Desktop to the foreground

commands.name: unread-chats
commands.title: Unread Chats
commands.description: View all chats with unread messages

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Send Message
commands.description: Quickly send a message to any chat

commands.name: contacts
commands.title: Contacts
commands.description: Search contacts across connected Beeper accounts

commands.name: search-all
commands.title: Search Everything
commands.description: Search across all Beeper chats and messages

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Beeper Desktop API Base URL
preferences.description: The base URL for Beeper Desktop API (default: http://localhost:23373)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
